agent.problem: The walkthrough never tells what the Danites actually say in Judges 18:25. This card only rules out an offer of repayment, and card 13 says merely that they warn Micah not to raise his voice. The explicit threat that angry men will attack Micah and that he and his family will lose their lives is omitted, leaving out a key detail of the confrontation.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.
